title: にゅうがくしきのあさ (Nyuugakushiki no Asa)
description: It's the morning of Ren's first day of elementary school — the entrance ceremony. From the nervous breakfast to the cherry blossoms at the school gate, from the long principal's speech to a whispered introduction from the boy next to them, Ren discovers that everyone around them is just as scared. By bedtime, the nerves have quietly turned into something that feels a lot like excitement.
author: オリジナル
